name: Weekly Retro Action Reminder
description: Every Sunday 9am, email open approved actions from the latest archived retro snapshot via Gmail.

prompts.text:
Follow the weekly-action-reminder skill in this repository.

1. Read docs/reminders/latest-reminder.json. If missing, stop: run archive + npm run export:reminder first.
2. Email recipients: use snapshot.recipients.to (array of email addresses). If absent, read docs/reminders/recipients.json. subjectPrefix from the same source.
3. IMPORTANT: action.teams / ownerTeams are team labels (Dev Team, QA Team) — never use them as Gmail recipients. Only send to addresses in recipients.to.
4. Compose concise HTML: sprint title, period, team, archived date, bullet list of open approved actions (id, title, teams label, target date, short description).
5. Include reportExcerpt.themesSummary when present.
6. Send via Gmail send_message with to=snapshot.recipients.to, subject: {subjectPrefix} Open actions — {title} ({period}).
7. Do not modify repository files, merge PRs, or change action status.
8. Use team/process language only; never deanonymize feedback.
